Necessary arrangements shall be made to avoid stagnation of water in BRT lanes, including removal of weeds, cleaning of vents and weep holes, removal of plastics, papers, leaves, cloths, etc., and ensuring free flow of water. Silt or soil spread over the road surface shall be removed during regular maintenance works. Soil deposits in the MTL lanes, if any, shall be removed as and when instructed by the Engineer-in-Charge.

raw.description: The scope of work consists of maintenance of BRT lanes, including removal of shrubs and weeds and disposal of the waste at the designated place, from Hosur Hubballi to Jubilee Circle, Dharwad, for one year during 2026-27. Cleaning shall also include the areas outside the periphery of Railway Station, BSNL, Mitrasamaj, CBT and NBS Dharwad Bus Stations, including disposal of the waste materials. tenders.title: Replacement of one no. very old 110KW/150HP capacity standby cooling water pump along with motor at Sharavathy Generating Station, KPCL jogfalls-577435, Shimoga Dist, Karnataka
tenders.location: KPCL Executive Engineer Turbine Office SVP Jog

raw.title: Replacement of one no. very old 110KW/150HP capacity standby cooling water pump along with motor at Sharavathy Generating Station, KPCL jogfalls-577435, Shimoga Dist, Karnataka
raw.description: Brief scope of work covers, Dismantling the existing cooling water pump motor sets along with concrete bed. All the civil works like removing the priming pipes cement bedding, concrete foundations of pump motor sets at EL 166 Ft. Turbine floor concrete foundation bedding works with suitable packets / opening for motor foundation bolts and pump foundation bolts and fabrication of metal frame structure for erection of motor as per detailed approved drawings of pump motor sets, leveling, curing etc. has to be carried out by contractor. Supply and erection of new motor and KPCL issued pump, leveling proper alignment on concrete bedding to match the existing old suction and delivery pipes flanges with hardware, Gaskets height of centerline of pump suction nozzle and delivery nozzle should match the existing suction pipe flanges and delivery pipe flanges centerline from foundation. Necessary pipes, flanges, bends, gaskets, hardware for retrofitting works and gas cuttings, welding, flanges holes drilling if any should be carried out by the contractor. Necessary gas cutting, nozzles, gas welding machines, welding rods concrete drilling / chipping tools other tools, tackles, chain pulley, pull lifts, terfers, cement, sand strengthening work of concrete with skilled technicians to be carried out. Local transportation for transporting men and material to site to be arranged by contractor. All other works of erection, testing and commissioning as per site Engineers directions should be carried out by the contractor. Detailed Technical Specifications and Scope of Work/Supplies are furnished in Section-III of bid document attached in the e-portal.
raw.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Turbine Office SVP Jog

tenders.title: Supply, installation, testing, commissioning, replacement & retrofitting of 16 nos. new soft starters for existing old star delta starter panels of 25HP Governor Oil pump motors of Sharavathy Generating Station
tenders.location: KPCL Executive Engineer Turbine Office SVP Jog

raw.title: Supply, installation, testing, commissioning, replacement & retrofitting of 16 nos. new soft starters for existing old star delta starter panels of 25HP Governor Oil pump motors of Sharavathy Generating Station
raw.description: Supply, installation, testing, commissioning, replacement and retrofitting of 16 Nos. 25HP, 415 V, 3 phase, 50Hz fully automatic soft starter units for Governor oil pump motors with over current, short circuit, phase loss, phase reversal, locked rotor protection along with associated contactors and components without altering the existing wiring scheme, with all the existing interlocks, protections and commissioning of the system at work site. The 25HP drive used in Soft Starters shall be of Make ABB/ Siemens / Schneider with 25HP drive of Model PSTX45-600-70 or equivalent and the supplied model should have interchangeability of parts and easy inventory management so as to suit the existing Governor oil pump starter panels. Since, the existing old star delta panels installed at SGS are equipped with contactors, fuses, isolator switching units and the same need to be replaced and retrofitted to soft starter panel. Replacement & retrofitting of 16 nos. new soft starters for 25 HP Governor oil pump motors of Make ABB/ Siemens / Schneider with 25 HP drive of Model PSTX45-600-70 or equivalent are as per Detailed Technical Specifications and Scope of Work/Supplies are as per Section-III of tender documents attached.

tenders.location: KPCL Executive Engineer Turbine Office SVP Jog

raw.title: Manufacture as per drawing, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of 04 nos. GOP honey comb heat exchangers in Sharavathy Generating Station
raw.description: The scope of work involves as follows, Manufacture as per drawing and supply of honey comb heat exchangers as per technical specification dismantling of existing old heat exchangers, stacking the same at specified place as directed by the engineer in charge at site. Installation, testing and commissioning of new honey comb heat exchangers. Supply of necessary O-ring/gaskets and bolts, nuts, washers are also covered in the scope of work. The heat exchanger flanges should exactly suit to PCD of heat exchanger housing body flange dimensions as per existing scheme. Detailed Technical Specifications and Scope of Work/Supplies are as per Section-III of tender documents attached.
